blocks.text: chr, which converts numeric codes to characters. Letters of the alphabet are encoded in alphabetical order, so for example:

blocks.description: The difference between the numeric codes of 'c' and 'a' is 2, reflecting alphabetical ordering.

blocks.text:
Because 'c' is the two-eth letter of the alphabet. But beware: the numeric codes for upper case letters are different.

Potentially offensive jokes on the Internet are sometimes encoded in ROT13, which is a Caesar cypher with rotation 13. If you are not easily offended, find and decode some of them. Solution: https://thinkpython.com/code/rotate.py.
